"""Camera-guided GR1 controller. One client, no reset, only camera/proprio inputs.
Interactive commands and all executed actions are recorded alongside this script.
"""
import json, pathlib, sys, time
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
CAMS = list(spec['cameras'])
obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, include_depth=True, video='none')
seq = 0
last_command = None

def save(res, label):
    global obs, seq, last_command
    obs = res
    folder = OUT/f'{seq:03d}_{label}'
    res.save(str(folder))
    values = dict(zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'], res.meta['proprio']['now']))
    cmdkeys = [k for k in values if k.startswith('cmd_')]
    if len(cmdkeys) == 24:
        last_command = np.array([values[k] for k in cmdkeys], dtype=float)
    print(json.dumps({'folder':str(folder),'meta':res.meta,'commands':cmdkeys}), flush=True)
    seq += 1

save(obs, 'initial')
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        c = json.loads(line)
        (OUT/'commands.jsonl').open('a').write(json.dumps(c)+'\n')
        if c['op']=='obs':
            save(r.get_obs(cameras=c.get('cameras',CAMS), seconds=c.get('seconds',0), include_depth=True, video=c.get('video','none')),c.get('label','obs'))
        elif c['op']=='act':
            A=np.asarray(c['actions'],dtype=float)
            np.save(OUT/f'actions_{seq:03d}.npy',A)
            save(r.submit('ee_pose',A,cameras=c.get('cameras',CAMS),include_depth=True,video=c.get('video','none'),note=c.get('label','act')),c.get('label','act'))
        elif c['op']=='move':
            start=last_command.copy()
            end=start.copy()
            for i,v in c['targets'].items(): end[int(i)]=v
            n=c.get('steps',60)
            f=np.linspace(0,1,n+1)[1:]
            f=f*f*(3-2*f)
            A=start[None,:]+f[:,None]*(end-start)[None,:]
            if c.get('hold',0): A=np.concatenate([A,np.tile(end,(c['hold'],1))])
            np.save(OUT/f'actions_{seq:03d}.npy',A)
            save(r.submit('ee_pose',A,cameras=c.get('cameras',CAMS),include_depth=True,video=c.get('video','none'),note=c.get('label','move')),c.get('label','move'))
        elif c['op']=='status': print(json.dumps(r.status()),flush=True)
        elif c['op']=='exit': break
    except Exception as exc:
        print(json.dumps({'error':repr(exc)}),flush=True)
PY
